name: m1.small
description: General-purpose small instance (1 vCPU, 512 MB memory). Ideal for lightweight web services or development environments.

name: m1.medium
description: Balanced general-purpose instance (2 vCPUs, 1 GB memory). Suitable for moderate workloads or staging services.

name: m1.large
description: General-purpose large instance (4 vCPUs, 2 GB memory). Ideal for production web apps or multi-service nodes.

name: c1.small
description: Compute-optimized small instance (2 vCPUs, 512 MB memory). High CPU-to-memory ratio for batch or worker tasks.

name: c1.medium
description: Compute-optimized medium instance (4 vCPUs, 1 GB memory). Designed for CPU-heavy workloads or analytics processing.

name: c1.large
description: Compute-optimized large instance (8 vCPUs, 2 GB memory). Suited for parallel computation, data transformation, or build servers.

name: r1.medium
description: Memory-optimized medium instance (2 vCPUs, 4 GB memory). Best for in-memory databases, caches, or JVM-based apps.

name: r1.large
description: Memory-optimized large instance (4 vCPUs, 8 GB memory). Designed for high-memory or large caching workloads.

name: g1.large
description: GPU-enabled instance (4 vCPUs, 8 GB memory). Used for ML inference, AI workloads, or CUDA-based computation. Requires GPU runtime.

name: m1.xlarge
description: General-purpose extra-large instance (8 vCPUs, 8 GB memory). Designed for mixed compute and memory workloads under sustained load.

name: c1.xlarge
description: Compute-optimized xlarge instance (16 vCPUs, 8 GB memory). Ideal for simulation, parallel compute, or containerized data pipelines.

name: r1.xlarge
description: Memory-optimized xlarge instance (8 vCPUs, 16 GB memory). Excellent for databases, caching layers, and heavy JVM workloads.
